Hook payload shapes for the Claude adapter tests (tests/test_agents_claude.py). Hand-sanitised from Claude Code 2.1.287 hook input:
ids are made up, paths are placeholders, prompts are replaced. Field names are the real ones. `stopfailure_rate_limit.json` is the shape
seen on the live box: the error TYPE is in `error` (not `error_type`) and the limit text is in `last_assistant_message`.
